$schema_note: Curated mapping from spec constructs to SDK symbols. Bootstrapped by scoring internal/types/shared.go and types.go json-tag sets against spec schema property-sets (dumpstructs + Jaccard scoring), then every entry below was verified by reading the corresponding SDK source and the spec. enums[].spec/types[].spec point at .api-sync/spec-current.json (or spec-snapshot.json) component schema names. types[].nested handles properties that are inline sub-objects in the spec (never $ref'd) rather than top-level schema properties; the nested key is the property name on the parent schema, and its own 'sdk' array is reconciled against that inline sub-object's properties instead of the parent's. types[].discriminator lists property names on the spec schema that the SDK injects as literal values per variant (see bankaccounts 'type', customers 'type'/'kyc_type') rather than modeling as a struct field; reconciliation excludes them from the missing-property computation.

enums.note: Verified against packages/api-contract/src/bank-account.schema.ts accountType = ['checking','saving']. This SDK already has the correct value 'saving' (unlike python/php/swift, which have a live 'savings' bug). Do not change.

Currency conflates two independent, disjoint spec enums used on the same GetFxRate requestBody: 'from' (stablecoins: USDC/USDT/USDB, exactly StablecoinToken) and 'to' (fiat: BRL/USD/MXN/COP/ARS/EUR). Anchored on 'to' since that is the superset side relevant to this type; 'from' is already fully covered by StablecoinToken. 'to' has no named component schema (inline object on the operation), hence the inline: pseudo-pointer -- the patcher's map-validity check treats an inline: schema value as informational-only (not resolved against spec-current.json's components.schemas).
SDK carries an extra 'pending' member not currently emitted by PayoutOut/PayinOut/TransferOut.status; harmless (SDK superset), left as-is.

tracking_payment is an inline (non-$ref'd) sub-object; property path is dotted to reach the nested 'step' enum. Same 4 values recur on tracking_transaction.step/tracking_complete.step across Payout/Payin/Transfer webhook schemas.

PRE-EXISTING BUG, not introduced by this PR: root types.go declares 'type BusinessIndustry = types.BusinessIndustry' but re-exports none of the 154 value constants (every other shared enum in this file has a matching const block; this one does not). Consumers of the public blindpay package cannot currently reference any BusinessIndustry value at all. Flagged prominently in this PR's description for a human to fix in its own PR (add the missing ~154-line const block to types.go); reexport intentionally left null here so map-validity does not fail on a re-export block that does not exist, and so a future enum-member addition does not try to patch it either. SDK also carries 11 qualitative categories (dapp, exchange, gambling, gaming, infra, marketplace, neo_bank, other, saas, social, wallet) absent from the current spec entirely; harmless (SDK superset).

types.note: POST create-bank-account returns BankAccountOut uniformly for every rail (verified against the spec response schema); the 11 per-rail CreateXxxResponse structs are each a narrower view of the same wire shape, so a property only needs to appear on at least one of the 12 sites, not all of them.

CreateBankAccountIn is one flat spec schema discriminated at runtime by 'type' (11 rail values); the SDK models 11 separate Create*Params structs plus a literal 'type' string injected in the request body (see bankaccounts/client.go CreatePix/CreateAch/etc.). A property is satisfied if present on at least one of the 11 sites.

CreateCustomerIn is one flat kitchen-sink spec schema (individual+business, standard+enhanced fields all optional/nullable side by side), discriminated at runtime by 'type'+'kyc_type' literals injected by the SDK (see customers/client.go CreateIndividualWithStandardKYC/CreateIndividualWithEnhancedKYC/CreateBusinessWithStandardKYB). A property is satisfied if present on at least one of the 3 sites; there is no 'light' kyc_type or enhanced-business variant in the SDK today (pre-existing, not part of this sync).

PayoutOnEvmOut is the response schema for all 3 payout creation operations (evm/stellar/solana), verified directly against the spec; payouts.CreateResponse backs all 3 SDK methods (CreateEvm/CreateStellar/CreateSolana).

Spec operation is POST .../payouts/stellar/authorize; SDK calls POST .../payouts/stellar/authorize-token (pre-existing path drift, see cmd/apisync coverage report and PR description; not changed in this PR).

2-way discriminator fan-out: CreateWithAddress injects is_account_abstraction=true, CreateWithHash injects is_account_abstraction=false (see wallets/client.go). A property is satisfied if present on either site.
